about_the_game:
Step into the playful yet professional world of Melanie, the sweet nurse who's secretly eager to relieve more than just stress. This DLC introduces Melanie as a captivating new character in Model Casting, complete with her personal storyline, seductive dialogues, and exclusive explicit H-scenes. Guide Melanie through flirtatious conversations, exploring her gentle personality that gradually reveals her playful, sensual side. Unlock intimate scenarios where Melanie's nurturing touch turns into irresistible seduction, ensuring an unforgettable experience of care and passion.

Key Features:

  • Exclusive Character: Melanie, a gentle nurse with hidden desires.

  • Three Engaging Chapters: The Interview, Lewd Meeting, and Lewd Visit (Sandbox).

  • Custom H-scenes: Crafted explicitly around Melanie's sweet yet naughty personality.

  • Provocative Dialogues: Experience immersive and sensual conversations.

  • Replayability: Multiple dialogue choices leading to varied explicit outcomes.
